# R7 Symmetry and movement on every screen

Owner brief (2026-11-28): "Website has to look visually symmetrical, gaps have to be even and borders, alignment and order have to be properly aligned. Every click, every move has to show some visual movement."

Scope: every real-account screen and the opening page. Two measured rules are added to the browser harness, then every screen is brought to zero findings. No behaviour, copy or data changes. The earlier rule still stands: flat, no tilt, no moving backgrounds, `/emergency` has no motion, reduced motion keeps feedback as fades.

Persona served: a 25 to 35 year old tech worker used to polished fintech apps. Uneven gaps and dead buttons read as "unfinished"; every hover, press and switch must answer them.

## R7.2 Symmetry rule: `expectAligned(page, label, sink?)`

Measured inside `main` (and the rail for rule 4), on visible elements, 1px tolerance. An element or container carrying `data-free` is skipped.

1. Even gaps: in every grid or flex container with three or more visible children laid out on one axis, the gaps between neighbours are equal. With two children nothing is measured.
2. Rows line up: children of one grid row, or of a flex row whose `align-items` is `stretch`, share top and bottom.
3. Controls line up: in a flex row, every `input`, `select`, `button` and link styled as a button has the same height and the same vertical centre.
4. Page edges: every block that is a direct child of a screen root and spans at least 90% of its width shares the root's left and right edge; the rail's bottom, the ask bar's bottom and the page's bottom padding line agree.
5. Even padding: a box with a visible border or its own background has equal left and right padding, and its first child's top inset equals its last child's bottom inset unless the box is a `flex` column with `justify-content: space-between` or `center`.
6. Text columns: in a list or table, each column's cells share a left edge (or a right edge when right-aligned), and a cell that is right-aligned is one line.

Widths are never compared: the approved 2fr/1fr, 5fr/6fr and 26/37/37 grids stay.

## R7.3 Movement rule: `expectMoves(page, label, sink?)` and `settle(page)`

`settle(page)`: waits until `document.getAnimations()` holds no running animation (5s limit).

`expectMoves`, for every visible, enabled interactive element in `main`, the rail, the sub-tabs and the ask bar (`a[href]`, `button`, `[role="tab"]`, `[role="switch"]`, `input`, `select`, `summary`, `label` holding a radio or checkbox), up to 40 per screen, each kind sampled:

1. Hover: after the pointer moves onto it and transitions end, at least one of background colour, border colour, colour, transform, text-decoration or outline differs from the resting style.
2. Press (links, buttons, tabs, switches): with the mouse held down, the computed `transform` is not `none`; the pointer then leaves before release, so nothing navigates.
3. Focus (keyboard): a visible outline of at least 2px.

For changes of content, tested per screen in R7.5: after a tab, pager, segmented or switch change, and after a route change, `getAnimations()` on the new content is non-empty within 50ms.

## R7.4 The layer (`app-theme.css`, under `.kv-app`)

- Keyframes `kv-rise` (opacity 0 and `translateY(8px)` to rest, `var(--t-slide)`, `var(--ease-enter)`) and `kv-fade` (opacity only, `var(--t-in)`). No other keyframes. Modules add none.
- Enter: the screen root (`main > *`) plays `kv-rise` on mount; `[role="tabpanel"]:not([hidden])`, and any element carrying `data-enter`, play `kv-rise`; components set `key` or `data-enter` so a pager, segmented or switch change replays it on the changed content only.
- Hover: buttons and button-links change background or border colour over `var(--t-in)`; text links gain an underline offset change and colour; cards that are links lift `translateY(-2px)` with a border colour change only where no ancestor hides overflow, otherwise border and background change; list and table rows change background to `var(--mist)`.
- Press: every link, button, tab and switch gets `transform: translateY(1px) scale(0.98)` over `var(--t-press)`; inline text links `translateY(1px)` only.
- Focus: `outline: 2px solid var(--harbour); outline-offset: 2px`, animated from offset 0 over `var(--t-in)`.
- Inputs and selects: border colour and a 2px ring animate on hover and focus. The ring is an `outline`; `box-shadow` stays banned.
- Values that change (stress test amounts, counts) roll with the existing `CountUp`.
- One control scale: control height 52px (`--ctl-h`), 48px under `@media (max-height: 760px)`; one radius for controls (14px) and one for cards (22px); border 1.5px everywhere; one gap scale 8, 12, 16, 24, 32, 48. Modules use these tokens; a different value needs `data-free` with a reason in a comment.
- `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)`: `kv-rise` becomes `kv-fade`, press and lift transforms are replaced by an opacity change of 0.85. `/emergency` keeps its motion-off layout.

## R7.5 Harness: `e2e/real-align.spec.ts`

One test per screen, each running `expectCalm`, `expectAligned` and `expectMoves` at 1440x900 and 1366x650, zero findings: opening page; home (two policies and one policy); my policies; policy page on every tab; compare; stress test (empty and with a bill); hospitals (before and after a search); every wizard step, the pay screen and the guidance screen. Plus: `a tab, a pager and a switch each animate their new content`; `moving between pages animates the new page`; `reduced motion keeps fades and drops transforms`.

Before fixing any screen, the builder runs the new rules on the unchanged tree and saves the raw `finding:` lines to `docs/build/evals/R7-baseline.txt`; the rules must flag at least: the policy page search field shorter than its button; its centred pager; its two-line right-aligned source cells; the rail and ask bar bottoms not agreeing on Home. A rule that misses these is corrected first.

## R7.6 Out of scope

New screens. Copy. Decorative motion (tilt, parallax, moving backgrounds, confetti). Landing files. New dependencies.
